problem_type: Misleading spend and no-cost user copy
symptom: User-visible copy says an upload, retrieval, retry, or model is free even when the application cannot prove zero provider cost for that user's account and operation.
direct_cause: Money wording is duplicated across renderer locale dictionaries, model display labels, and desktop translations; the existing no-cost scan only covered a subset of no-cost claim variants.
class_root: There is no shared invariant that every user-visible money claim must be backed by a known local fact or an explicitly scoped provider fact; unknown cost is therefore silently phrased as free.
affected_population: All users viewing zh-CN or English model onboarding, model labels, generation error recovery, or asset-upload failure copy.
entry_points: desktopT translations consumed by Electron error and onboarding paths
internal_only_reason: This remediation enforces Nomi's internal copy invariant; provider prices and quotas are deliberately not asserted without a scoped source.
invariants: Unknown or account-dependent cost is never phrased as free, zero, no charge, or free retry.
A true local/offline or explicitly scoped provider fact may remain only in its existing allowlisted wording.
Recovery copy describes the available retrieval action without asserting a new cost outcome.

door_reduction.why_not: The renderer locale readers, model display reader, and desktop translation reader are separate runtime boundaries and must remain separate; the fix centralizes the claim scan across the renderer dictionary boundary and edits the desktop source strings at their shared table.

generality_proof: The scanner now checks the existing no-cost claims plus the previously uncovered free upload/retry/retrieve variants for every loaded zh-CN and English dictionary key. The changed copy removes the same claims from both renderer and desktop tables, so equivalent onboarding, model-label, upload-failure, and recovery entries converge on the same unknown-cost wording rule.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Scans every loaded locale value and rejects unsupported no-cost claims while preserving explicit allowlists.
Loads the renderer's zh-CN and English dictionaries consumed by user-facing components.
Single desktop translation table for main-process user-facing error and recovery copy.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: KIE upload copy is changed in both locales and the dictionary scanner covers both values.
Qwen labels no longer add an unscoped free claim; the source model metadata remains unchanged.
Upload-channel copy no longer calls an external host free; known local-only copy remains outside the changed claim.
Recovery strings no longer promise free retrieval or retry.
The copy states the existing-result lookup is no-charge because it only polls an already submitted task and never starts a new generation request.
This task changes user-visible copy only; the free metadata controls billing semantics and is intentionally not changed.

recurrence.reason: The same unsupported claim can be reintroduced through any new locale key or desktop translation entry.
same_class_scan: rg -n "免费|free|预算|budget|已花|spent|\$0|¥0" src/i18n electron/desktopStrings.ts src/config src/workbench

prevention.invariant: Every loaded locale value is rejected when it contains an unsupported zero-cost/retry claim.
prevention.failure_mode: The test reports locale and key and exits non-zero before merge.
prevention.strategy: Extend the existing i18n test boundary with the missed claim variants instead of adding a second check-* gate.

legacy_paths.rationale: No persisted data or runtime path changes; only unsupported user copy is removed.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency controls this copy invariant.

migration: Not needed; existing keys remain stable and only their displayed text changes.
residual_risks: Real provider charges remain account-specific; the UI must continue to use the existing price/unknown-cost paths for generation confirmation.

The real Electron unknown-price walk passed with zh/en payment-card screenshots; task-center and production-details before/after captures remain unverified and are listed explicitly in docs/evidence/2026-10-08-money-copy/README.md.
